_comment: JOURNEYS for scripts/compare-env.mjs — flows walked on BOTH environments in
lockstep, with a screenshot + full comparison taken at EVERY step.
id     — short slug (used for --journey and for the image file names)
name   — shown in the report
path   — where the journey starts
auth   — true = only runs when the comparison is signed in (--auth)
steps  — the checkpoints. Each one is:
label  what this screen is, in the report
do     actions to perform BEFORE photographing (omit on step 1)
{ "click": "English" }  button name, visible text, or css/xpath
{ "fill": "<selector>", "value": "…" }
{ "waitFor": "<text or selector>" }
{ "wait": <ms> }
wait   settle time before the photo
writes true = this step creates real data (sends an OTP, submits a
signup). SKIPPED unless the run is started with --allow-writes,
so a routine comparison never registers users on production.
{{email}} / {{stamp}} in any value are replaced per run with a unique
yopmail address and timestamp, so write-enabled runs do not collide.
Run one:  npm run compare -- --auth --journey create-account
Run all:  npm run compare:journeys

journeys.name: Create account
journeys.note: The signup wizard, screen by screen. Typing is compared; the OTP send and submit are write steps.

journeys.name: Login with password
journeys.note: The login screen, screen by screen. Credentials are typed but never submitted unless --allow-writes.

journeys.name: Account settings tabs
journeys.note: Every tab of the signed-in Account area, compared one after another. Nothing is saved.
